notes_for_editor: Disagreements stated in text: appropriation year (1877 HAER vs 1878 LHF/site) and cost ($100,000 vs $40,000); tower height 108 ft vs 110 ft 3 in; reef light order (fifth vs sixth); oil house date (LHF 1893 vs Board reports 1891-92/1894); electrification Dec 1923 (LHF) vs 1924 (site); NRHP 1980 (site timeline) vs 1984 (record, LHF); Bevry end 1944 (USLHS) vs 1945 (LHF). Newspapers were not searched (the Chronicling America query timed out), the corpus holds no Light-House Board reports before 1891, and no early keeper detail (1880s) beyond LHF. The 1900 report page was not located by corpus.py page; footnote cites the volume only. Fiscal 1900 whistle figures matched by OCR text; the oil-house 1894 entry is in the volume bound for 1893-94 and may belong to fiscal 1894. Bevry/Lonne quoted details (children, steps, heart attack) come from LighthouseFriends only. 1918 Driad aid is LHF-only. Wikipedia's coordinates (42.7645) look wrong; the record's 42.781 matches USLHS (42 46 51 N). Post-1960 USCG personnel are listed in the roster only and not named in the prose.
